verdict.rationale: Kimi ships agent surfaces (Kimi Code CLI, Desktop, the editor sidebar and the assistant's Agent mode), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents adding or connecting MCP servers. The Kimi plugins/skills help topic, ACP editor connectivity and the API's tool-search endpoint are related features, not MCP-server plug-in support, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
